question: What quantity of practice situated in the forehead-letter-mass must the god-worshipped practitioner accomplish?
premises: A hundred-thousand repetitions constitute the prescribed quantity.
This practice is situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
The instruction is directed to one who is worshipped by the gods.
inference: Accomplishing a hundred-thousand repetitions at the forehead-letter locus fulfills the enjoined practice.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the act counted as lakṣaṃ (recitation, visualization, or other) is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand [repetitions] situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
